notes.title: :Great changes coming soon:
notes.content:
Hello dear players, I'm the creator, developer and artist of Vindictive Drive, I wanted to make this announcement to let you know about the last update of this game.

I have been watching the reactions of the community, and just like the first time I did, with the help of your suggestions, bug reports and feedback, I am proud to say Vindictive Drive will be now a better and more enjoyable story to play.

Some of the changes in progress are:
*Bugs fixed, some of the most notable being the ones related to helper robots
*The difficultly of some puzzles will be changed, including that big one in chapter 7.
*New areas added with more information about some characters' background stories.
*Animation scenes fixed to be more fluid
*Some scenes completely remade to make the game flow faster where it should do it.
*Language options.
*Changes in tools, weapons and helper robots .
*If given the conditions in your session, Eureka will be available as usable helper robot for more time.

The update will be announced with a small animation featuring Luna Herz, voiced by the wonderful and talented MikuLeRoux.

Also, a few special surprises I have been preparing for a long time that I want to keep a secret, I can't give you an ETA right now because lately my free time has been changing a lot, but I read all your posts and I have all of them in mind to make a better game, thank you immensely.

- Bal

notes.title: Vindictive Drive released on STEAM!
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

After 4 months in "Early Access" Vindictive Drive is finally available on STEAM today! Here's developer quote about the final update:

This update extends the game to ten chapters, completing the story and I also had in mind the critics and reviews of the Early Access version to make the game more balanced and enjoyable.

This version also adds a good bunch of weapons and tools, and also gives the player the choice of acquiring one of the two helper robots that will guide the gameplay mechanics into either stealth or action shooter scenarios depending on which they like the most, and a secret hidden character they can unlock near the end.

This is a story driven thriller game with dark themes and a very sour, suicidal main character who has nothing to lose and it's obviously not an average heroine, in a stealth/action game;not the easiest story or the easiest game to make, but I'm very grateful with the players, they literally helped me build this game, one of them even became involved in the project as a tester/proofreader.

I am also grateful with those who will play it after this release, it took quite a lot of work and time to make, and I hope people enjoy it as much as I do.

- Balthasar
